b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line downloader.

## Usage

```
tinydl [options] <url>
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Help |
|--------|------|
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Description

`tinydl` downloads a file from the given URL and writes it to a file or stdout. It retries on failure up to a configurable limit and reports the number of bytes downloaded on stderr unless quiet mode is enabled.'
